description_en: Requests the work number platform to create a call binding relationship (B, X, A) for employee B's work number X, allowing employee B to call customer A through work number X
description_zh: 接入方调用本接口向工作号平台请求为员工B的工作号X建立呼叫绑定关系（B，X，A），允许员工B通过工作号X呼叫客户A
name: BindAXBCall

parameters.help_en: The request deduplication ID. The maximum length is 20 characters. Ensure the atomicity of the request ID
parameters.help_zh: 请求去重ID，最大长度为20位，请确保请求ID的原子性
parameters.name: req_id

parameters.help_en: The customer UID. The system automatically obtains this value. You do not need to specify it
parameters.help_zh: 客户UID，系统自动获取，无需输入
parameters.name: caller_parent_id

parameters.help_en: The phone number of customer A
parameters.name: tela

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the BX binding relationship
parameters.name: auth_id

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the binding relationship. The value must be greater than 0. Unit: seconds. Binding time + expiration time = automatic unbinding time
parameters.help_zh: 绑定关系过期失效时间：取值必须大于0；单位：秒，绑定时间 + 过期失效时间 = 自动解绑时间
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: The pass-through parameter that you can customize
parameters.help_zh: 回传参数，客户可自定义
parameters.name: user_data
